(513)don gnyis pa dbyar gnas ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa lags so/ /(514)don gnyis pa dbyar gnas ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/sbyo

tei:div.tei:p: (513)don gnyis pa dbyar gnas ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa lags so// (514)don gnyis pa dbyar gnas ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba ni/

dbyar snga ma yin na zla ba drug pa dang*/ dbyar phyi ma yin na bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi snga dro nas/ dge skos dang*/ zhal ta ba/ khang skyong sogs nas do dam mdzad de/ gtsug lag khang phyi nang kun tu khyab par phyag dar bya ba dang*/ yol ba bres pa/ rgyan gdags pa/ khri stan bshams pa/ khor yug tu mchod stegs bca' ba sogs sla chos dang rtsing chos su ma song bar brjid la mdzes par bkod/ tshul shing rtse khru gang pa ya yo med par 'jam la drang ba dri bzang gis mdog ser por bsgyur ba dge 'dun gyi grangs las lhag pa dang*/ ston pa'i na bza' ser po dri ma med pa dang*/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi tshul shing la bzang gos sna tshogs pa'i cod pan gyis spras pa tshags su gzhug go / ༈ gral tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin gung tshigs zin pa dang*/ mkhar rnga'i brdas bskul te/ dbyar gnas par spro ba dge slong dge tshul thams cad kyis bla gos/ dge slong rnams kyis snam sbyar/ gding ba/ rtse zhwa bcas thogs nas kun kyang zhi dul dang ldan pas dran pa nye bar bzhag ste 'du khang du tshes bco lnga dang*/ bcu drug gi nyin gyi 'don pa phyag len dang*/ spyod lam thams cad 'di dang 'di ltar dgos zhes/ phan tshun zhib gros byas te/ dbyar bdag pa gnyis kyis gtsos 'dus pa thams cad kyis (515) thugs nges bya/ bslab gral yang lo zla zhag dang skyes bu rkang pa tsam yang ma 'chol bar bya/ dge tshul gyi gzhon mtha' nas brtsams chab ril ba gnyis/ dung pa gnyis/ mkhar rnga ba gcig gaṇḍi pa gcig chab gtor gyi phyag len pa/ mkhan po'i gsol 'dren pa rnams legs par bskos/ 'di skabs dge tshul rnams kyis rang rang gi mkhan po/ slob dpon/ dge rgan rnams la tshul shing len grogs bcol dgos/ de nas thams cad rang gral du 'khod nas lhod chags par 'dug mkhan po khri la 'khod de/ thams cad kyis gang blo ma 'don pas mtshams sbyar te/ dbyar gnas kyi tshe slob sbyang*/

spyod lam/ ngag bcad/ 'khrugs slong gi rgyu rnyed pa bsgo ba/ chos gos kha bsgyur ba sogs don dang bya ba ma rung pa/ mtshams kyi phyi rol tu skya rengs 'char bar mi bya ba la sogs pa thams cad bshad par bya/ 'dus pa thams cad kyis thugs nges byas nas lag len la thebs pa gal che/ de rjes spos bsu rgya gling gis mdun bsus te/ dge slong thams cad kyis bla gos/ snam sbyar/ gding ba bcas thogs/ rtse zhwa bzhes te mkhan pos thog drangs bslab gral bzhin ser sbrengs kyis rung khang du phebs/ thams cad kyis zhwa phrag tu bkal/ las byed mkhan pos/ gnas la blo mthun bgyi bas las mdzad pa'i gnas 'di nye 'khor dang bcas pa tshun chad rung khang gi gnas su blo bstun pa gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsaul/ gnas thams cad lags pa nang (516)mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung khang gi gnas su blo mthun par bzhed na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung khang gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi'o// 'di ni gsol ba'o/ brjod pa mjug sdud dang bcas pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung khang gi gnas su bzhed de de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung khang gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsungs shig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung khang gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi lags te/

'di ltar cang mi gsungs bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to// de nas thams cad kyis zhwa mnab/ spyod lam de nyid kyis/ sku rten du thub pa'i dbang po'i snang brnyan thub chen khang nas dang / (517) gsung rten du 'dul ba pod bcu gsum bstan 'gyur khang nas dang*/ thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rtain sku gdung khang rten nas dang*/ gzhan yang skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing gi zhal thang rnams bslab gral ltar phyag tu thogs te 'du khang nang nas g.yas bskor du bskor ba byas nas/ mchod stegs dbus su ston pa'i sku gzugs/ g.yas phyogs su stegs mtho ba la 'dul ba'i pod rnams dang*/ g.yon phyogs su rnam rgyal mchod rten dang*/ thang sku rnams g.yas thang g.yon thang ma nor bar legs par bkod par bya'o// de dag gi mdun du mchod stegs bang rim lnga pa dkyus su ring ba steng khebs dang bcas pa bkod pa'i khyad par du ma dang bcas pa bshams/ de dag grub zin nas zhal ta ba dpon g.yog rnams kyis dge tshul slong rnams la pham rgyal med par gsol phogs 'bul bar bya/ kun kyis phyag bsnams mdzad nas tshogs grol bar bya'o// de na zhal ta ba/ ma byan chu len rnams nas rung khang du thab 'dzin pa sogs bya'o// mchod dpon gnyis grogs dge tshul rnams dang bcas pas zan sla ba ma yin pa las zhal zas mtho gang las mi chung ba brgya las/ rtse khram can bco lnga/ dam can spyi gtor dpung rang 'khor dang theb skyus bskor ba dang*/ rgyal chen rnam sras sgrub gtor mchod gtor gang rung dang*/ gzhan yang gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha'i gtor zlum theb ril can chang bu bzhis bskor ba rtse khram nor bus (518) mtshan pa can brjid la mdzes pa bzos te/ bang rim gong ma la bkod/ de'i 'og tu zhal zas gzhan rnams dang*/ de'i 'og tu bdun tshar nas kyis bkang ba phreng ba bstar ba la/ me tog dang spos spel mar bshams pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu chu sbreng tshar du bkod/

de'i 'og tu mar me'i phreng ba/ rgyun bzhag gi tshe 'bar sogs legs par bkod/ gzhan yang nyin re bzhin du 'bul rgyu'i dzam lha'i gtor ril/ 'byung ba bzhi/ bar do cha bzhi'i gtor ma rnams shin tu bzo dbyibs ma 'khrul bar 'du bya'o// bang rim 'og ma la 'phrog gtor/ gsol ka gtor 'bul sogs bkod/ gzhan yang khrus chog sogs yon kha bton dgos tshe de dag gi dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma sogs kyang grub dgos/ tshul shing rnams kyang gzeb kyi srog mar ras dkar bting ba'i khar bzhag de'i steng du staun pa'i tshul shing 'phan dang bcas pa bkod nas/ mchod stegs kyi zur ram gang bder bzhag go// tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa'o// ༈ gral tshes bco lnga'i snga zhog ri rtser nyi ma shar ba dang*/ dung pa gnyis bla gos dang*/ rtse zhwa gzhing ba bcas thogs nas sgo'i steng spen bad khar 'greng ste/ dung brda sngon du 'gro ba'i dung sbrel ma gsum 'bud par bya/ de'i tshe chab ril bas rung chu byin brlab bya/ gaṇḍi pas kyang las kyi gaṇḍi rgyud gcig dang tog gsum brdung ba sogs gso sbyong (519) gi skabs ji lta ba bzhin du shes par bya ba las/ khyad par cung zad yod pa ni/ phyir bcos grub nas thad gral du bslab gral ltar 'khod pa dang*/ bstod pa tshigs bcad gcig pa/ khyad par 'phags bstod/ sdom rgyun gsol 'debs dang*/ rgyun chags gsum pa/ tshul khrims rnam dag gi mdo zin nas/ gsol ja'i skabs/ 'jig rten mchod 'os dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas gang rung la dbyangs sho lo ka gsum re btang*/ de nas lhug 'don mthar dbyar bdag pas ja zhus dang*/ lan gdab/ ja bzhes zin nas/ dge tshul gso sbyong*/ dge tshul rnams phyi rol du bkar ba'i dus/ phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma so sor gdab dgos/ dge slong rnams ltung thun byin brlab nas gnas la blo mthun zin nas/ mtshams bu chung bcad nas dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par bya ste/

mkhan pos/ slar yang mtshams bu chung bcad cing dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun pa gsol ba'i las pa thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'di na dge slong gnas pa dang gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis mtshams bu chung gi phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod pa shar phyogs su ni seng ldeng gi phur bus btab pa lags/ lho phyogs su srad bus bres pa lags/ nub phyogs su ni rdo bzhag pa lags/ byang phyogs su ni srol btod pa brtan po lags (520)na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyi mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams bu chung bcad cing dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad do// 'di ni gsol ba'o// brjod pa mjug sdud dang bcas pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'di na dge slong gnas pa dang gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis mtshams bu chung gi phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod pa shar phyogs su ni seng ldeng gi phur pas btab pa lags/ lho phyogs su ni srad bus bres pa lags/ nub phyogs su ni rdo bzhag pa lags/ byang phyogs su ni srol btod pa brtan po lags te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge 'dun gyi mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang*/ dge slong rnams bde la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams bu chung bcad cing dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du 'di lta ste gnas bsdu ba dang*/ dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams bu chung bcad cing dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsungs shig

(521)gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang*/ dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams bu chung bcad cing dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par bgyis lags te 'di ltar cang mi gsungs bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to// zhes brjod pas mtshams bu chung bcad/ so sor thar pa la ston pa'i 'du shes= sogs nas/ g.yag rnga'i rtse mo ji bzhin no// zhes pa'i bar gso sbyong gi skabs ji lta ba lags/ mjug tu dbyar mi gnas pa'i tshogs pa rnams kyi ched du/ bsngo smon/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos= sho lo ka gnyis/ rin chen dge tshogs= sangs rgyas bstan pa= gang du skyes pa'i= phan bde'i 'byung nas= dbyar gnas bzhugs mkhan sha stag yin na bsngo smon mi dgos/ snang grags rig gsum= skar ma rab rib= sogs kyis grol/ dbyar gnas pa rnams kyis bla gos dang snam sbyar rang rang gi gral du bzhag nas nang nas g.yas bskor du phebs/ gung seng mdzad pa dang chabs gcig dbyar mi gnas pa rnams kyang grol/ dbyar gnas pa rnams de ma thag mkhar rnga'i brdas bskul te slar tshogs/ dge slong rnams kyis snam sbyar bzhes te dge 'dun thams cad rang gral du 'khod/ thug pa drangs/ chab brim rjes dge tshul rnams bla gos gding ba dang bcas yol ba'i rgyab tu (522) 'phred gral du 'khod pa dang mnyam du/ mkhan pos gnas mal stob par bskos pa'i dbyar bdag pa gnyis la/ dge slong thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba dang*/ thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba khyod gnyis dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stob par spro'am/ zhes 'dri/ de gnyis kyis rang gral nas stan las phyed 'phags pas/ spro lags zhu/ mkhan pos/ khong dag spro bar gda' bas gnas mal stobs pa bsko ba la gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bgyi bas dge 'dun rnams spyod lam bstun nas/

thog mar gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba dang*/ thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba 'di dag dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stob par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stob par bskos te/ dge slong gnas mal stob pa thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stob bo// 'di ni gsol ba'o// brjod pa mjug sdud dang bcas pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong= zhes bgyi ba de dag dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stob par spro ste/ (523)de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong= zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stob par bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong= zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stob par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsungs shig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang na dge 'dun gyis dge slong= zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stob par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsungs bas de de bzhin tu 'dzin to// zhes brjod/ de ma thag dbyar bdag gzhon pas tshul shing rnams rgan gral mthar bzhag gral gsham nas dbyar bdag rgan pas gding ba'i steng nas/ phyag gsum 'tshal nas/ gzan gal khyer rkang lag 'dud rgya dang bcas te/ dbyar gyi khrims brjod par bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang (thub bstan bkra shis dge 'phel bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling )zhes bya ba 'di na khrims su bya ba dge sbyong gi chos bzhi las mi 'da' bar bya ba 'di dang*/ chos spyod bcu'i bya ba la brtson pas bslab par bya ba 'di dang*/ dbyar dge 'dun gyi nang du 'khrugs long mi skyed par bya ba 'di dang*/ ltung ba gleng dran mi bya ba 'di dang*/

chad pas gcod pa'i las mi bya ba 'di dang*/ gnas ral ba dang (524)grum pa bcos par bya ba 'di dang*/ byin gyis ma brlabs par mtshams kyi phyi rol tu skya rengs 'char bar bya ba 'di dang*/ dge 'dun gyi spyi'i gdan la zhabs rjen par mi 'jog pa 'di dang*/ byin gyis ma brlabs par zhal bshal ba'i chu dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang du mi 'dor bar bya ba la sogs pa 'di yod/ khyed cag las gang khrims su bya ba 'di dang 'dis/ gnas 'dir gnas par spro ba des ni tshul shing bzhes shig khyed cag las sus kyang dbyar dge 'dun gyi nang du 'khrugs long bskyed par mi bya'o// khyed cag las gang gis 'ga' zhig la cung zad shes pa des da smros shig khyed cag las gang dbyar gyi nang du dge 'dun la 'khrugs long bskyed par 'gyur ba de la/ dge 'dun gyis phyis nye bar brtag par dgongs so// zhes brjod gding ba bzhi bltabs phyag g.yon du bkal nas dge tshul rnams kyi gral gshams su gding ba bzhi bltabs kyi khar gzan shad dang bcas pas dbyar gyi khrims/ dge 'dun btsun pa= bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag= sogs nas/ nye bar brtag par dgongs so/ bar lan gcig brjod/ de nas dbyar bdag pa gding ba dang bcas rang gral du bzhugs/ de nas mkhan pos/ tshul shing bzhes pa dang dbyar gnas par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i slad du dge 'dun rnams thugs bstun pa gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan (525)du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyis dbyar nye bar sgrub pa dbyar zla 'bring po'am/ tha chung gi tshes bco lnga lags na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis deng tshul shing bzhes te/ sang nangs par dbyar gnas par khas blang ngo*// 'di ni gsol ba'o//

zhes brjod/ de nas dbyar bdag rgan gzhon gnyis ka bzhengs nas ston pa'i tshul shing yod pa'i srog ma rgan pa'i phyag tu thogs la/ gcig shos gzhon pas bsnams nas gral gsham du 'greng bzhin dang*/ dbyar bdag pa rgan pas ston pa'i tshul shing gi sne'i cod pan lag g.yas su phog par byas nas gung srin gyi sne gnyis nas bzung ste/ 'di ni bdag cag gi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas des bzhes par mdzad do// zhes brjod bzhin par spyi bor reg cing ston pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar dal bus phul/ de nas dbyar bdag rgan gzhon gnyis kyis tshul shing gi snod phyag tu thogs nas rgan pas/ mkhan pos nas bzung g.yas gral du bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan rnams la rim par brim la/ dbyar bdag gzhon pas g.yon gral ba rnams la rim bzhin du brim par bya'o// gral gcig las med na rgan pas gral 'go dang*/ gzhon pas gral (526) phyed tsam nas brtsams dgos/ de len pa po rnams kyis cang mi smra bar stan las phyed 'phags te dal bus blangs nas rang gi pang du bzhag dbyar bdag pas rang rang gi tshul shing blangs te rang gi lcog steng bzhag de nas dge slong rnams rdzogs rjes su/ slar yang dge tshul rnams kyi ched du sngar bzhin dbyar bdag rgan pas mkhan po sogs dge slong bslab pa rgan gral dang*/ gzhon pas gzhon gral rnams la brim dgos la/ brim tshul gong dang 'dra/ de'i dge tshul gyi tshul shing bzhes dgos pa dag gis spyod lam snga ma lta bus/ stan las phyed 'phags kyis/ 'di ni shākya'i dge tshul bkra shis bzang po'i 'o/ zhes pa lta bu'i rang rang la gang bcol ba'i dge tshul de dang de'i ming nas smos te dal bus blangs te pang du bzhag la/ yang dbyar bdag rgan pas tshul shing srog ma mkhan po'i drung du phul te/ mkhan pos stan las phyed 'phags kyis/ 'di ni gtsug lag khang 'di na gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha'i 'o// zhes pas blangs te mchod gtor gyis 'phrog gtor phul ba'o//

de nas dbyar bdag gnyis kyis dang por dge slong rnams kyi tshul shing rgan pas rgan gral gyi mjug nas yar bsdu la/ dbyar bdag gzhon pas gzhon gral ba'i mjug nas yar bsdus te snod du re re nas bsgrangs te/ dbyar bdag rgan pas (527) gding ba rkyang bting khar phyag gsum dang*/ gzan gal khyer rkang lag 'dud rgya dang bcas te/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang= zhes bya ba 'dir dge slong bcu phrag bcu dang brgyad kyis tshul shing bzhes so// sogs grangs brjod/ de nas dge tshul rnams kyis tshul shing bsdu tshul sngar ji lta ba las/ phyag dang bcas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang= zhes bya ba 'dir dge tshul bcu phrag bcu tshan gsum dang*/ brgyad kyis tshul shing bzhes so// sngar bzhin grangs brjod/ dge tshul rnams la zhu mi dgos te/ thos pa'i nye logs su yod pa'o// de nas gnas mal stob pa ni/ dbyar bdag pa gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang gi lde'u mig dang gzhan rnams kyis rang rang khang pa'i lde'u mig gnyis lhan du 'dud rgyas bzung nas/ dbyar bdag rgan pas mkhan po nas bzung rgan rim dang*/ gzhon pas dge slong gzhon gral ba rnams la brim tshul yang*/ tshul shing dus ltar las/ mkhan pos/ gtsug lag khang 'di ni gos kyi rnyed pa sogs yo byad dang ldan pa lags kyi bzhes shig zhes brjod/ rang bab bslab pa rgan pa rnams la/ gnas brtan/ zhes brjod/ rang bab bslab pa gzhon pa rnams la/ btsun pa/ zhes brjod/ dge tshul rnams la/ tshe dang ldan pa/ zhes brjod do// de nas gdan cha 'bogs pa ni/ sngar tshul shing skabs ltar dbyar bdag pa gnyis gral g.yas g.yon du phyin pa rang gi gding ba gral (528) gdan bcas kyi sne yul rten ga nyis kas lhan cig tu 'dud rgyas bzung nas/ gdan cha 'di la dbyar tshul dang mthun par longs spyod cig ces re re brjod/ dbyar bdag gnyis kyis gnas mal dang*/

gdan cha 'bogs mi dgos pas/ gzhan rnams kyis 'bogs zin pa dang*/ dbyar bdag rgan pas gral gsham du gding ba'i khar phyag gsum bcas gding ba'i khrims brjod pa ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ khyed cag las gang gis kyang dge 'dun gyi gnas mal la gding ba med par longs spyod par mi bya/ gding ba rung ba ma yin pas longs spyod par mi bya/ gding ba dri ma can gyis longs spyad par mi bya'o// zhes go bar byas nas/ de ma thag spyod lam de nyid kyis/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge 'dun sang gi gdugs la sbyin bdag skye bo'i tshogs lha dang mi dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang bcas pa du ma dang*/ zhal ta pa thub bstan= zhes bya ba dang*/ spyod yul gyi grong (rnam rgyal byang chub chos gling )zhes bya ba/ bro g.yog pa thub bstan= zhes bya ba 'di rnams la bsten te dbyar gnas par zhal gyis bzhes par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod nas gding ba bzhi lteb kyis/ dge tshul rnams kyis gral gsham du gzan shad bcas/ gding khrims brjod pa/ dge 'dun btsun (529)pa sogs nas/ zhal gyis bzhes par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i bar sngar ltar brjod nas dge tshul rnams nang du phebs te rang gral du bzhugs/ dbyar bdag pas thog drangs dbyar khas len blo rgyugs rim bzhin mthar chags su len/ ja) btang*/ chab phul/ de nas mkhan pos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas dgongs su gsol/ bar gong ltar dang*/ mkhan pos bskul te/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos= sogs tshigs bcad gnyis/ rin chen dge tshogs= sho lo ka sangs rgyas bstan pa= gang du skyes pa'i= phan bde'i 'byung gnas= de ltar 'grub par= gyur cig bar dang*/ byang 'dren pas bskul te/ dam pa rnams kyi zhabs brtan dang*/ rgyal ba kun kyi= sa la 'og min= thub bstan mdzes pa'i= snga 'gyur bstan pa= bkra shis phan bde'i= bkra shis rgyal ba= bslab pa gsum ldan= snang grags rig gsum=

skye ba kun tu= skar ma rab rib= tshogs grol ba'i bskor ba la rgya gling dang spos bsu bcas mdzad dgos/ de rnams dgung tshigs kyi snga rol du grub par bya ba rnams te/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin ji ltar dbyar gnas pa'i sbyor ba'i cho ga yin no// ༈ dbyar khas blang ba dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ tshes bcu drug gi zhogs par dung dang gaṇḍis bskul te ston pa'i spyan sngar thad gral du 'greng ste/ phyag gsum sngon du 'gro bas gdan la pus btsug gi 'dug nas/ tshigs bcad (530) bzhi pa dang*/ lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod pa/ mdo bskul la/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan po= zhes bgyi bas gtsor mdzad dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dbyar snga ma zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dus lags te/ gtsug lag khang gi bdag po dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi lha rnams kyi slad du zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa re bklag tu gsol/ zhes tshig phrad bsgyur ba byas rjes rgyun chags gsum pa gtor ma bsngo bar byas la dge slong rnams rang rang gi gral du bzhugs/ dge tshul rnams yol ba'i rgyab tu gral bsgrigs nas/ mkhan po khri la bzhugs bzhin pa la dbyar bdag gnyis nas gding ba brkyang bting khar phyag gsum 'tshal nas/ gzan gal khyer 'dud rgya dang bcas te 'greng ste/ bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed dam par gyur pa btsun pa 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po dbyar khas len gyi cho ga la thugs gtad par zhu/ mkhan pos/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang bar zhu/ lan gyis tsog pur bzhugs/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir/ gnas ral ba dang grum pa bcos pa'i slad du/ sbyin bdag skye bo'i tshogs du ma dang*/ zhal ta ba thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba (531)dang*/ spyod yul gyi grong (rnam rgyal byang chub chos gling )zhes bgyi ba dang*/

bro g.yog pa thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba sogs la bsten nas dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blang ngo*// bdag dbyar 'di na gnas shing bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags so/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod/ thabs legs bya/ slar yang phyag sogs gong bzhin byas nas/ bstan pa rin po che'i= dbyar khas len gyi cho ga la thugs gtad pa bka' drin che lags/ zhes zhu/ mkhan po nas/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang ba bka' drin che lags/ zhes lan byin/ de nas mkhan po khri las bzhengs te/ rgan gral mgor phebs nas grogs dge slong rgan pa gnyis dang bcas te gsum kas dbyar bdag rgan bo'i drung du spyod lam gong du dbyar bdag gnyis kyi ji lta ba bzhin dbyar zhal bzhes gnang*/ mkhan pos dbyar zhal bzhes zin ma thag khri la 'khod/ mkhan po dang gnas brtan rnams kyis gzan shad dang gzhan rnams nas kyang bslab thob ltar mdzad/ de nas dbyar bdag rgan pa'i drung du spyod lam de lta bus g.yas gral mthar chags dang*/ dbyar bdag gzhon pa'i drung du g.yon gral mthar chags su khas blangs nas dge slong rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ de nas dge tshul rnams kyis khas len par bya ste/ gral gnyis yod na/ dbyar bdag rgan (532) pas dge tshul rgan pa dang*/ dbyar bdag gzhon pas dge tshul gzhon gral dang*/ gral gcig las med na/ rgan pas gral 'go nas dang*/ gzhon pas gral sked nas brtsams te tshul snga ma dge slong rnams kyis ji lta ba bzhin du khas blangs gnang dgos/ bka' drin che lags dang*/ rjes su yi rang bslab thob ltar brjod/ snam sbyar phud pa bcas/ de rnams grub rjes/ dge tshul rnams rang gral du bzhugs ma thag tu btang*/ ja mchod la gdangs mdzad/ chab ril ba gnyis kyis dbyar bdag pa'i zhwa dang gding ba gral gsham du bting byas la/ dbyar bdag pa gral rgyab nas dal bus gding ba'i khar phyag gsum sngon du 'gro bas ja zhus mdzad de/ yang chab ril ba gcig pos gding ba bzhi bltab du dbyar bdag pa'i gral du bting*/

gcig gis rtse zhwa lag tu thog nas zhabs phyi zhu dgos/ dbyar bdag pa gral du ma 'dug bar mkhan pos gtsos 'dus pa rnams kyis phor pa phyag tu thogs pa las ja mi gsol/ 'di'i 'og tu dbyar gnas pa'i skabs kun la 'gre/ chab len zin pa dang chab gtor btang ba dang*/ snang grags rig gsum= skar ma rab rib= kyis tshogs grol te nang nas g.yas phyogs su bskor ba mdzad de phyi rol du g.yas bskor byas nas kun dga' ra bar phebs dgos so// de nas (533) slar mkhar rnga dang gaṇḍis bskul te gtsug lag khang du phebs/ de nas bzung nyin re bzhin ji ltar bya ba 'og nas 'byung ba ltar ro// ༈ de nas tshes bcu bdun nas bzung dbyar gnas kyi ring la ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa ni/ zhogs pa nyi ma 'char dus nye ba na/ dung pa gnyis sngon du 'gro ste/ sgo khang gi steng du spen bad kha nas bla gos dang rtse zhwa bzhes te gzan zlum khyer gyis 'greng ste/ dung brda' dung skad dkyus ma dang*/ gzhan gsum bsgrigs dung skad kyis 'bud/ mchod bshams rdul phyag rnams kyang 'di dang mnyam du grub dgos/ gling drug gi nyi ma shar ba tsam gyi dus su/ dung gnyis pa 'bud skabs/ gaṇḍi pas gding ba ring bting khar phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bzhi bltab steng gaṇḍi brdung*/ brdung tshul the'us shad tsha lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ gso sbyong gi dus su las kyi gaṇḍi dang*/ rgyun du dge 'dun bsdu ba'i phyir rgyud gsum dang tog gsum brdung/ dbyar bdag gnyis kyang gaṇḍi pa'i sngon du 'ong nas/ mdo bskul sogs nyin res mos byed dgos phyir/ gang gi res la bab pa de nyid mkhan po'i gzims shag tu zhabs phyi gus pa dang bcas phebs/ mkhan pos kyang chos gos bzhes bzhin gzan zlum khyer mdzad nas phebs dgos/ dbyar bdag gcig shos kyi drung du chab ril gang res bab pa des rung chu byin brlabs gos te dbyar bdag pas bla dgos bzhes/ gding ba

(534) bzhi bltab khar gzan zlum khyer gyis tsog pur bzhugs/ chab ril pas bla gos bzhes/ gding ba brkyang bting khar phyag gsum gzan gal khyer rkang lag 'dud pa dang bcas/ bstan pa rin po che'i= rung chu byin brlabs kyi cho ga la thugs gtad par zhu/ brjod/ dbyar bdag pas/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang bar zhu/ brjod/ de nas gnyis ka tsog pur/ rung chu'i snod de yul rten gnyis ka'i lag g.yon pa'i mthil du bzhag phyag g.yon pas steng nas bkab ste/ chab ril pas/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul= zhes bgyi bas sman 'di dag grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis bgyi ba thun tshod du rung bar byin gyis brlab bo/ zhes lan gsum bzlas mthar/ thabs legs bya/ phyag dang spyod lam snga ma lta bus/ bstan pa rin= rung chu byin brlabs kyi cho ga la thugs gtad pa bka' drin che lags/ zhes gsol/ yul gyis/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang ba la rjes su yi rangs/ zhes brjod dgos so/ de nas dge 'dun pa thams cad kyis mchil lham phud/ sgo khang nang du 'dus nas thams cad kyis bla gos bzhes/ gzan zlum khyer mdzad/ snam sbyar dang gding ba thogs/ dbyar bdag pas kyang bla gos spos bam la me sbar ba dar thag dang bcas 'dzin bzhin/ mkhan pos/ thog drang nas go rim ma 'khrugs bar nang du phebs dus/ chab ril ba gnyis kyis bla gos dang bcas (535) gding ba bzhi bltab kyi khar gzan zlum khyer gyis sgo zur g.yas g.yon du 'greng bzhin gus pa dang bcas 'bul ba bzhes te bzed zhal du dor bar byas nas/ gaṇḍi ci'i phyir brdung re re nas 'dri bar bya'o// des kyang*/ dge 'dun bsdu ba'i phyir ro// zhes lan gdab par bya'o// de nas dri gtsang khang du pheb nas rgyud chags gsum pa gsungs dgos kyang*/ 'dir 'du khang du ston pa'i mdun du thad gral gyi gding ba rkyang bting gi khar phyag gsum thams cad bsgrigs te 'tshal nas/

gdan la tsog pu thal sbyar gyis 'khod la/ byang 'dren pas bskul te/ nyin re bzhin tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa dang khyad par 'phags bstod gnyis dang*/ (khyad par 'phags bstod skabs/ gang slad khyod kyi bstan pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ dbyar bdag pas snam sbyar bzhes/ bdag gi bsod nams nas phyag 'tshal/ mgon po khyad par 'phags bstod nas 'dus pa bying nas snam sbyar bzhes dgos/ mchan/) tshigs bcad bzhi pa dang*/ lha las phul phyung gnyis sbrel te res mos bya'o// (lha las phul byung skabs/ gang la skyon ni mi mnga' zhing*/ /zhes pa nas dbyar bdag pas snam sbyar gsol/ padma kha phye rgyas= nas phyag 'tshal/ bdag gi tshig gis bskrun= nas 'dus pa bying nas snam sbyar bzhes/ mchan/) de dag gi mjug tu dbyar bdag gnyis gang res su bab pa des rang gral nas gding ba brkyang bting gi khar phyag gsum 'dud pa dang bcas te/ ba stan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa mkhan (536)po= gtsor mdzad dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng zla ba mar gyi ngo'i gral tshes gnyis pa mngon du gyur pa lags te/ gtsug lag khang gi bdag po dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi lha rnams kyi slad du zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa re bklag tu gsol/

mkhan pos bskul te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa= sogs nas gtor ma bsngo ba'i bar gso sbyong gi skabs ltar byas la/ de nas mkhan po'i khrir gding ba gnyis bltab dang*/ gzhan rnams kyis gding ba bzhi bltab bya/ snam sbyar phud pa'i khar zlum khyer gyis rang rang gral du bzhugs ma thag byang 'dren pas bskul te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra bi ma na sa ra ma hā dza ba hūm̐/ dge ba'i 'gyur sngags sngon du btang nas/ ltung bshags dal 'don tshar gcig 'phros/ mang ja) dang po/ ja mchod/ 'jig rten mchod 'os= dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas= gnyis res re mos su sho lo ka gsum re gdangs dang bcas pa lhod la dal chags par dgos/ gsol ja sogs bzed pa'i tshe yang phyag gnyis kas legs par bzed/ dge g.yog rnams kyis tshogs khang nang du gsol ja bzhag la rung chu 'debs/ 'dren mkhan dge tshul rnams nas legs par 'dren/ de'ang gus shing zhib pa rtsing spyod du ma song ba gal che/ ja mchod kyang rang blos gang dran mi bya bar ja zhus yod tshe 'di gnyis ma gtogs mi byed cing brel dal skabs dang bstun nas byed dgos/ ja mchod mgo blang ba dang*/ mkhan po (537) nas bzung gsol zhal mthar chags su len pa las gang byung byung mi byed par phyag gnyis kas bsnams/ bzed pa'i tshe yang gong smos ltar phyag gnyis kas mthar chags su bzed pa kun la 'gre/ 'di skabs ja zhus yod tshe dge tshul chab ril ba gnyis kyis 'don pa dang bstun pas/ gcig gis rtse zhwa dang*/ gcig gis gding ba thogs nas sngar ltar gral gsham du brkyang bting dgos/ de nas dbyar bdag pas/ hrīḥbla ma yi dam= dang*/ thub dbang rgyal ba= zhes pa tsam gyis skabs su 'don pa brel dal dang bstun te/ dang po'i tshe thur 'ded nas phyag gsum dang rtse zhwa lag tu thogs la ja zhus mdzad/ de la lan byin/ de ma thag dbyar bdag rang gral du ma 'khod bar kun kyis ja mi bzhes/ chab ril ba gnyis kyang de ma thag rang gral du 'khod/

spyir btang dbyar gnas kyi ring la/ dge slong rnams kyis rgyun chags gsum pa dang*/ gung tshigs/ chos 'chad nyan rnams la snam sbyar bzhes dgos/ gtsug lag khang gi nang du phebs nas bzung kun dga' ra bar ma sleb bar ngag bcad sdom dgos shing*/ smra ba bcad pa 'di gal che shos yin pas ja skabs sogs kun la ngag sdom dgos/ ja bzhes zin pa dang*/ chab ril ba gnyis kyis chab brim zhing bsdu/ de nas dge tshul chab gtor gyi phyag len mthong brgyud ltar rang bzos spangs ste bshams pa sogs bya/ byang 'dren pas bskul te/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs sems dang*/ rang nyid skad cig chu gtor (538) cha lnga/ dzaṃ gtor cha bzhi/ gtor ma brgya rtsa/ 'byung bzhi glud gtor/ bar do cha bzhi bcas bsnon 'phri med par lhod la dal chags par bya/ mjug tu rtag tu gdab pa'i smon lam rnam drug gang du skyes pa'i= brjod/ ja) btang*/ gsol zho 'dren rgyu byung tshe skabs 'dir 'dren/ 'dren bzhes kyi tshul thug pa'i skabs ltar dgos/ gzhan gyi rim gro sogs sgrub dgos na skabs 'dir btang*/ de nas/ snang grags= skar ma= brjod la tshogs grol/ mkhan po nas rgan rim bzhin ser sbrengs kyis lha khang nas ston pa'i sku la g.yas bskor gyis phyir phebs nas phyi nas kyang g.yas bskor gyi rnam pas kun dga' ra bar phebs pa ni tshogs nam grol dus kun la 'dra bas kun kyis thugs nges byas nas skabs gang bde byed mi rung*/ spyod lam gzan zlum khyer la sogs pa legs par bslab ste lag tu blang dgos/ kun dga' ra bar bzhugs pa'i tshe gang blo ma dang bcas skyor sbyong dang*/ dogs gcod byed pa zhi lhag gi ting nge 'dzin la bslab pa sogs spang blang gi bya bas dus 'da' ba las/ don med kyi long gtam ku re dang bzhad gad/ rgyug mchong rtsed mo'i rigs la sogs gzhan ma dad pa skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i spyod lam ngan pa kun spangs te/

kun spyod bzang po bstan pa'i mig rgyan du 'gro ba la nges par bslab par bya'o// rang gar grwa khang du 'gro bar mi bya/ gal te 'gro (539) dgos byung tshe/ mkhan po dang dbyar bdag pa la gnang ba zhus nas gnang ba ma byung bar 'gro bar mi bya'o// tshogs thengs gnyis pa la/ mkhar rnga dang*/ gaṇḍis bskul te/ sngar bskor ba'i 'phro bskyang nas ser sbrengs kyis phebs/ sgo khang du chab bzhes gnang nas gral gshams nas phebs te rang gral la 'khod pa dang*/ byang 'dren pas bskul te/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis dang por byang chub= sogs nas/ mdzad bcu bstod pa che chung re mos dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mi pham chos rjes brtsams pa'i mkhan slob chos rgyal gsum gyi bstod pa dang*/ kun mkhyen chos rje'i bstod pa bcas res mos 'dir btang*/ de nas sdom rgyun gsol 'debs/ mtshan dpe'i gzugs sku dang*/ thub mchog byin rlabs gter mdzod/ gnas brtan phyag mchod rnams gsungs/ de'i ring la dge skos dang chab ril ba gnyis bcas kyis spos 'dren bya dgos te/ de'i tshul ni/ chab ril pa gcig gis dbyar bdag pa'i gding ba bting bsdu dang*/ gcig shos kyis zhwa dang snam sbyar spos bam dar thag thogs la zhabs phyi byed/ dbyar bdag pas gral gsham nas phyag gsum dang*/ mkhan po'i mdun spos phul/ phyag dbang zhu/ de nas gral gsham du chab ril pas spos bam la me sbar ba dang bcas phyag tu phul/ zhwa dang bcas spos bskor bya zhing*/ ston pa'i sku dang*/ mkhan po (540) la lnga bskor/ dge slong la gsum bskor/ dge tshul rnams la gnyis bskor bya zhing*/ skor zin pa'i dus su chab ril pas zhwa/ snam sbyar spos rnams len dgos/ mtshams 'dir thug pa 'dren te/ rgan rim bzhin mthar chags su len pa dang*/ stob pa pos lag gnyis kas stob pa dang*/ len pa pos kyang lag gnyis kas len pa sogs byin len tshul bzhin gnang dgos/ gsol ba'i tshe 'ang*/

cag cag hu hu/ phu phu la sogs pa 'dul ba dang 'gal ba'i nyes spyod spangs te gsol dgos/ zhag cu tsam song nas 'don rgyugs dang*/ bshad pa 'bel gtam byed pa kun/ gsol thang gi tshe dang*/ ja bzhi pa'i skabs gnyis la btang rgyu yin/ de rjes su chab bkye bsdu byas nas/ dbyar bdag pas gral gsham nas phyag dang bcas skyabs 'jug zhu dgos yod na zhu/ de nas sdom gsum le'u dang po nas so thar le'u yan/ chos tshul 'di yang= sho lo ka spyi blug mdun du 'jog byams smon gsungs/ nyin gnyis par byang sems yan 'don res dang*/ spyir tshogs thun dang por/ ltung bshags dang*/ gnyis par byams smon/ gsum par bzang spyod/ bzhi par ltung bshags bcas zhal nas gsungs pa'i smon lam rnam gsum zer bas chag med dgos/ snang grags rig gsum= skar ma rab rib= brjod nas tshogs grol lugs gong ltar bya/ kun rar phebs (541) nas/ slob gsar rnams kyis rgyugs 'bul sogs bya/ de nas nyin gung la bab pa na/ tshogs thengs gsum par mkhar rnga dang*/ gaṇḍis bskul te snga ma ltar phebs nas sgo khang du chab bzhes/ gral du 'khod pa dang dal bus lhung bzed mdun du bstar ba sogs bya/ ja)btang*/ 'bul bzed sngar ltar/ byang 'dren pas bskul te/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa dang mnyam du thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar/ lhung bzed pang du blangs nas/ zhal phud bca'/ gung tshig gnang*/ chab bzhes/ lhag ma bsngo/ yon sbyang sngags dang*/ sbyin pa'i tshigs bcad/ sher snying bdud bzlog bcas grub nas byang 'dren pas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i skabs su kun kyis thal mo sbyar/ gang blo ma tshar gsum/ brtse ldan khyed kyi= bzang spyod yan lag bdun ma/ phyag gi rjes su/ dge 'dun pa kun nas maṇḍal bzang ngan la ma ltos par re bsnams pa 'bul zhing*/ maṇḍal so bdun ma dang*/ yan lag phyi ma rnams song rjes/

sems can rnams kyi= chos bskul bcas zin nas mkhan pos zhwa bzhes te/ bdud tshar gcod pa'i sngags blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdor gsungs pa ltar dang*/ chos 'chad pa'i sngon 'gro rnams lhag chad med par grub nas/ nyin dang por kun slong kun spyod (542) kyi rnam dbye dang*/ chos la gus pa bsod nams kyi mchog tu nges pa rnams legs par bkral nas/ bstan pa'i snying po sdom pa gsum gyi legs bshad nyin re bzhin chos thun re 'chad dgos/ de yang bshad gzhi'i le'u dang*/ so thar gyi le'u gnyis blos gang lcog shin tu rgyas pa zhag sum cu so lnga tsam dang*/ byang sems la zhag lnga/ sngags la nyin gnyis/ mjug bsdu ba'i nyin gcig tsam dang*/ dbyar grol ba'i tshes nyi shu bdun nyin par rdzogs par bya'o// chos thun rdzogs pa dang*/ bsngo ba'i thugs 'dun bskul nas/ byang 'dren pas/ bsod nams 'di yis= bzang spyod/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas= sogs cha tshang dang*/ gsol ka'i dam can spyi gtor dbu nas bstod pa'i mthar/ gnam chos kyi gtor bsngo/ bskang thung gnyis rnam sras/ ser chen sprin gseb ma bskang ba dang bcas gter gzhi gnyis dang gtor 'gugs nas bkra shis bar bya dgos/ bsdu na/ rnam sras ser chen dang*/ gtor bsngo/ bskang ba gnyis/ gang zhig yid la= phrin bcol dang*/ sngon tshe o rgyan= shis pa brjod pa bcas bya/ de nas thams cad kyis bla gos bzhes bzhin pa la rdor dril bsnams/ rtse zhwa phrag la bkal/ gding ba phyag tu bsnams/ tshogs grol lugs snga ma lta bus kun rar phebs te/ mchod dpon gyis gral gsham du cha gsum mthong rgyud ltar bshams/ zhwa bzhes te cha gsum (543) gsungs/ zla 6 pa'i tshes 16 dbu dang*/ zla 7 pa'i tshes 8 gzhung dang*/ zla 7 tshes 27 mjug gsum la 'don rta sogs rgyas pa re dang*/ gzhan rnams lhug 'don gyis btang*/ cha gsum zin nas zhwa phud nas phrag tu bkal/ sad bsrung gi phyir rgyun bsang bsdus pa dang*/

dkar gsur/ gnam chos nā ga raksha'i mngon rtogs bzlas pa las sbyor bsnyen pa dang bcas pa dang*/ stong tshig gi mchod bstaud/ skyabs gnas bslu med sogs dus ngan zhi ba'i smon lam/ 'jig rten bde zhing= shis pa brjod/ de nas chos thun nang ma go ba rnams yang du skyor dgos pa rnams skyor sbyong legs par byed/ de nas tshogs thengs bzhi par mkhar rnga dang gaṇḍis bskul te/ bla gos bzhes/ zhwa phrag tu bkal/ gding ba lag tu thogs nas sngar bzhin phebs/ chab bzhes/ gral du 'khod/ ja)btang*/ chab bkye bsdu bya/ dbyar bdag pas rten bzhag sogs kyi bsngo yig zhu/ byang 'dren pas/ ltung bshags tshar gsum/ spyod 'jug bsngo le/ mdo smon/ sngags smon gsum po nyin gsum po res mos su bya'o// ja) chab bkye bsdu bya/ mchod dpon gyis nas 'gyed/ zhwa pang du rtse g.yas su bstan la bzhag pa'i steng 'og lag pas 'du rgya dang*/ gzan sne g.yas mdun du phab la/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs= sogs dang*/ ye dharmā'i dus kun kyis zhwa bzhes te/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa brjod/ snga 'gyur bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam chos rgyal dgyes pa'i zhal lung*/ rgyal ba kun kyi= sa la= thub bstan= snga 'gyur=(544)bkra shis= bkra shis= bslab pa= snang grags= skye ba= skar ma rab rib= kyis tshogs grol tshe thams cad kyis bla gos bzhes bzhin snam sbyar phrag tu thogs te/ dbyar bdag pas spos sna dang bcas/ mkhan pos mdun bsus te gtsug lag gi nang du g.yas bskor gyis phebs nas sgo khag du 'ong skabs chab ril pas sgo drung du ril ba nas rung chu bkye ste/ dge slong so so'i chab ril sogs su blug gung thun ja la 'debs/ de phan bzhag mi rung zhing*/ chu snod ja khu sogs la 'debs par mi bya'o// de ni rung khang du ja blang nas rang skyil du gsol ba'i dbang du byas kyi rang skyil du g.yos dang kha zas sogs ni mi rung ngo*// mdor na rung chu ni/

byin brlab nas snod zur pa gcig tu bzhag ste ja thug nam gtong ba'i tshe chab ril pas de la 'debs par bya ba'o// dbyar gnas kyi ring la gso sbyong nam yod dus la de nyin cha gsum dang*/ do nub grol ba'i skor la dung dkar dang rgya gling spros dgos/ dbyar bdag pas spos dang bcas mkhan po gzims gshag tu zhabs phyi bya'o// de yan rgyun du ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa'o/ / ༈ tshes 30 dang*/ tshes 8 dang*/ tshes 15 gsum la gso sbyong dgos pa'i sngar nyin la dge tshul rnams nas lha khang byi 'dor gyis mdzes shing 'od chags par bya ba dang*/ tshes brgyad gso sbyong (545) gi dus so thar mdo ril 'don bya dgos/ de nyin gnas brtan phyag mchod la na bza' sogs gsar pa bzhes/ rol mo'i rigs byed thams cad tshags su gzhug ste mdun du bstar zhing bzang gos sogs kyis 'geb bcas thams cad bzhengs/ snam sbyar dang zhwa bzhes/ dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan 'dren gyer zhing*/ mtshams mtshams su gnas brtan mchod rol bya/ khrus sku phyi/ na bza' dbul ba sogs rjes thams cad zhwa phud/ gdan la bzhugs rjes/ phyag 'tshal bston pa sogs dgos/ ༈ dmigs bsal mtshams kyi phyi rol du mchi dgos byung na/ dgung bdun tshun chad byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi ched yin na zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i las sogs ni gzhung du shes par bya dgos la/ zhag gcig mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'gro dgos na'ang*/ byin gyis ma brlabs par 'gro bar mi bya'o// de'i tshul ni/ mtshams nang du dge slong chos dgu ldan gyi drung du tsog pur 'dug ste/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming= zhes bgyi bas nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir/ dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blangs pa las/ bdag ming= 'di zhes bgyi ba chos ldan gyi bya ba 'ga' zhig gi slad du/ dgung gcig mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar byin gyis brlab bo//

bdag dbyar (546)'di na mchis shing*/ bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags so// lan gsum/ thabs legs/ zhes byin gyis brlabs tai 'gro bar bya'o// sang nyin grong chog lta bur 'byon dgos pa'i tshe/ nyin snga mar kun rar bzhugs skabs/ zhal ta pa dang*/ dge tshul bcas kyis so sor brda sbyar/ de nas nang du tshogs/ dbyar bdag rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'greng bzhin phyag dang bcas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsaul/ dge 'dun sang gi gdugs la sbyin bdag che ge zhes bgyi bas/ dge slong bcu gsum dang*/ dge tshul lnga bcas gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren par 'tshal bas/ gang phebs par bzhes pa de dag gis tshul shing bzhes shig ces brjod pas tshul shing brim par sngar gyi brda' sbyar ba rnams kyis len/ brim len tshul yang sngar dbyar khas blangs pa'i dus ltar yin/ sang snga bar tshul shing blangs pa'i dge tshul slong rnams kyis mkhan po dang dbyar bdag pa sogs gang yang rung ba'i drung nas dbyar byin gyis brlabs te 'gro bar bya'o// de yang gnas brtan bgres pa des mkhar bsil thogs pas mdun bsus nas bslab gral ltar zhwa dang bcas ser sbrengs kyis phebs par bya'o// sbyin bdag gang gi gnas dang nye bar gyur pa'i tshe/ dge tshul zhal ta pa dag sngon la phyin te bsang btang zhing dung 'bud par bya'o// dge 'dun rnams sgor phebs pa dang mchil lham phud/ chab bzhes/
(547) bgos pa'i stan la go rim bzhin gding ba bting*/ klog bzhes te bzhugs par bya'o// ngag bcad/ chab bkye bsdu dang gung tshigs sogs rgyun gyi bya ba rnams ma nyams pa la bslab par bya'o/// /
